answer: Proof of Burn offers a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where agents must destroy scarce native tokens to gain network weight. By treating each burnt unit as a digital ember, the protocol ensures that acquiring identity is not free. An attacker faces an insurmountable cost to simulate a diverse lagoon of participants, as every new persona requires a cryptographic cipher signature backed by verified capital expenditure, rendering large-scale identity replication economically ruinous.
